title: Operator Evidence Envelope (operator-evidence/1)
description: v1.2 canonical operator-evidence/1 envelope — the authorization-relevant evidence record streamed to the Operator Console and mobile clients (§12.1). Canonical shape is camelCase, matching the live operator plane (apps/bifrost/src/operator/contracts.ts EvidenceEnvelopeSchema) and the harness gate mirror (harness/contracts/operator-evidence.schema.json). Envelopes are hash-chain-linked via payloadHash/parentHash and reference chain receipts; they are evidence records, never authorization decisions (§11.3). See Camelot-OS SADD+LLDD v1.2 §12.1, §11.3, and §19.
